Fresno County is the agricultural heart of the San Joaquin Valley, with Fresno and Clovis anchoring a metro of more than a million people surrounded by the nation's most productive farm ground. Industrial and logistics development along Highway 99 and the high-speed-rail alignment is the growth story, while SGMA groundwater restrictions, disadvantaged-community water systems, and Measure C transportation funding shape what can be served.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau · Data verified: November 8, 2026
